images.note: Real screenshot from Apache Airflow's own official documentation, showing the Admin > Connections list screen — the exact real screen a student checks when a failure turns out to be a bad or missing connection, tying directly back to Chapter 3's Connections lesson.

imageNote: Found via curl against airflow.apache.org's raw HTML (confirmed not JS-rendered, per this catalog's Ch1 finding). Checked ch01/01-why-orchestration and ch06/27-monitoring-and-logging's sources.json first: neither uses admin_connections.png (Ch1 used dag_overview_dashboard.png, Lesson 27 used dag_overview_grid.png and dag_task_instance_logs.png) — no overlap. This is the real screen behind one specific step in the diagnostic checklist ('check Connections'), so it earns its place rather than being decorative; the rest of the checklist (read the error, check upstream status, code bug vs. environment) is covered with an honest original LTV steps diagram since there's no single screen that represents a diagnostic thought process.
